segments.label: Global ceiling and unique durable range
Bounded funded attempts and checked result

messages.label: Acquisition plan and deadline
messages.note: At most 4 admitted acquisitions; validation CPU=2. Reject duplicate rotation identities before funding.

messages.label: Reserve all candidate maxima
messages.note: Initial data.go.kr key: 2 units; optional next key: 1. VC maxima: 98/50/2.

messages.label: CAS unique range within ceiling
messages.note: Checked min(block, remaining); bounded CAS contention is distinct from exhaustion. No deletion or reset.

messages.label: Completed 200: owned range
messages.note: Unknown outcome grants no HTTP; a committed high-water remains spent.

messages.label: Witness acknowledged
messages.note: Failure burns the acknowledged range and denies this acquisition.

messages.label: Private funded reservation
messages.note: Repeat candidate funding before any provider request; replacement never reuses leftover blocks.

messages.label: Status and bounded body
messages.note: Terminal 03: no-data in RAM, no retry. Deterministic 10/12 are rejected. Quota/auth and HTTP status precedence remains.

messages.label: Only allowed and funded: attempt 2
messages.note: Quota/auth may rotate key; transient errors may retry. Never a third HTTP.

messages.label: Final data, no-data or typed failure
Checked acquisition or denial
messages.note: Data still requires complete raw/group publication. No-data bytes stay in memory; the later port owns compatible wire semantics.

cards.title: Ceiling and ownership
items: CAS high-water allocates non-overlapping ranges; a durable witness precedes private subdivision.
Every configured key maximum is funded before HTTP. Policy/window identity is trusted configuration.

cards.title: Replacement and uncertainty
items: Unknown writes, abandoned reservations and unused prior-host blocks are never refunded.
No HTTP without verified admission. An uncommitted write with no durable record cannot be discovered.

cards.title: Scope and cost
items: New block: 3 S3 waves per key; two cold candidates: 6. Warm owned block: no funding request.
Internal primitive: no live AWS/IAM/quota conformance, deployed route or integrated S07 adapter.
